The '''Coruscant Health Office (CHO)''', also known as the '''Coruscant Health Administration (CHA)''', or '''Coruscant Health Authority''' or simply '''Coruscant Health''', was an organization within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that was responsible for the health care of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] citizens. The agency was also responsible for running medcenters on Coruscant. [[Coruscant Health Official]]s were in charge of issuing warnings and analysis of disease, enacting quarantines, and giving vaccinations.

==History==
[[File:CHA_warning.jpg|thumb|left|180px|CHA health advisory]]
This administration was founded before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], it was headed by [[Medxec]] [[Harribore Onuta]]. During that time, an increase in [[Brainworm Rot Type A]] in the [[Manarai Heights/Legends|Manarai Heights]] district of Coruscant, caused the CHA to increase quarantines and vaccinations especially for travelers entering Coruscant at [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] such as [[Eastport/Legends|Eastport]].

Later, [[Coruscant Health Official]]s were a part of a special report on [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]] and their increased use by youth on Coruscant.

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Republic Treasury/Legends|Republic Treasury]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Besany Wennen]] was attempting to discover where the funds for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] had come from. In an attempt to see how wounded [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were handled, she called the CHA policy planning department. Their she learned that the CHA only handled civilian cases and none from the GAR.

Later, Wennen began an armed siege at a CHA medcenter to prevent a comatose [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]], [[Fi Skirata|Fi]], from having his life support removed. Wennen was rescued by [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jaller Obrim]] and other [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] from the CSF [[Anti-Terrorism Unit]]. Wennen worried that the CHA administrators would call her boss and have her fired though Obrim promised her not to worry.

In [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi's]] underground [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the CHA's logo was present on the bombs he used to spread the virus. The flashing warning signs in the lab were set off when the virus was released also displayed the symbol. [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks's]] bio-suits had this symbol on their chest sections.

==Behind the scenes==
The logo for the Coruscant Health Administration appeared in episodes seventeen and eighteen of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', "[[Blue Shadow Virus (episode)|Blue Shadow Virus]]" and "[[Mystery of a Thousand Moons]]."
